name: Linear
description: Issues, команды и проекты Linear через GraphQL API.

auth.tokenHint: Settings → API → Personal API keys. Ключ передаётся без префикса Bearer.

tools.name: linear_list_teams
tools.description: List Linear teams with ids and keys.

tools.name: linear_list_my_issues
tools.description: List issues assigned to the current user.

body.query: query { viewer { assignedIssues(first: 30, orderBy: updatedAt) { nodes { identifier title priority url state { name } team { key } } } } }
query($term: String!) { issueSearch(term: $term, first: 20) { nodes { identifier title state { name } url team { key } assignee { name } } } }

tools.name: linear_create_issue
tools.description: Create a Linear issue in a team.

body.query: mutation($teamId: String!, $title: String!, $description: String) { issueCreate(input: { teamId: $teamId, title: $title, description: $description }) { success issue { identifier title url } } }

tools.name: linear_update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue title or description by issue id.

body.query: mutation($id: String!, $title: String, $description: String) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: { title: $title, description: $description }) { success issue { identifier title url } } }

tools.name: linear_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Linear issue.

body.query: mutation($issueId: String!, $body: String!) { commentCreate(input: { issueId: $issueId, body: $body }) { success comment { url } } }
